title: Nightshift
description: This is a PvP resource pack 1.20.1-1.21.11
body:
# About The Project

This resource pack is designed specifically for **PvP** gameplay on Minecraft versions **1.20.1 – 1.21.11**. It optimizes visual elements to give you a cleaner look and a competitive advantage during fights.

## Key Features

* 🎮 **Updated UI:** Clean and modern user interface for better focus.
* 📦 **Custom Textures:** Refined item and block textures tailored for PvP.
*   🛡️ **Armor Durability Display:** Shows the durability of your opponent's armor (*Requires OptiFine*).
* 👁️ **Night Vision:** Built-in fullbright feature so you can see perfectly in the dark (*Requires OptiFine*).

## ⚠️ Important Note
Features like **Armor Durability** and **Night Vision** strictly require **OptiFine** to function properly. 
If you are using **Fabric** or **Quilt**, make sure to install alternative mods like *Entity Texture Features (ETF)* and *GammaUtils* to achieve the same effects.
